title: Movie Crush: Tig Notaro on Mask
summary: Movie Crush episode in which host Chuck Bryant interviews comedian Tig Notaro about the 1985 film Mask (directed by Peter Bogdanovich, starring Cher, Eric Stoltz, and Sam Elliott). The episode opens with Chuck explaining that Tig received news just before the interview that her five-year cancer check came back clear, and that she chose to proceed. The conversation covers Tig's Mississippi and Houston roots, HBO movie memories, the Bob Seger versus Springsteen soundtrack controversy, the biker and blind-camp scenes, her motorcycles, her early career working as an assistant for Sam Raimi, her show One Mississippi, and a closing "Movie Crush" quiz-style segment with Roger Ebert's review and movie questions.

segments.title: Opening: Tig's surprise news before the interview
segments.summary: Chuck Bryant explains that before recording, Tig Notaro was emotional and had just received a call from her doctor that her five-year cancer results were clear. She chose to go ahead with the interview, and the hosts talk about the moment.

segments.title: Tig's Mississippi roots and Birmingham liberal ranking
segments.summary: Tig discusses her family ties to Mississippi, growing up in Jackson, Pass Christian, Spring, Texas, and summers in New Orleans and Hattiesburg. They also discuss a ranking of Birmingham as a liberal Southern city.

segments.title: Mask and early HBO movie memories
segments.summary: The hosts introduce Mask and discuss watching HBO movies growing up, including Under the Rainbow. Tig mentions she rewatched Mask on a low-quality YouTube copy and has seen it many times.

segments.title: Cast trivia and behind-the-scenes stories of Mask
segments.summary: They discuss Eric Stoltz's role, crew anecdotes about his makeup, and the age difference between Stoltz and Cher. They also discuss One Mississippi and the Mask soundtrack dispute between Springsteen and Bob Seger, with Bogdanovich's lawsuit.

segments.title: Bikers, motorcycles and Tig's riding stories
segments.summary: The conversation turns to the biker community in Mask, including the puppies and blood drive scene. Tig shares her childhood mini-bike accident, buying a motorcycle at seventeen, and her current motorcycles.

segments.title: Sam Raimi's file cabinet and Kevin Costner trivia
segments.summary: Tig recalls working as an assistant for Sam Raimi, keeping his file cabinet, and a conference call with Kevin Costner. Kevin Costner's production company, Kicking Bird Productions, is also discussed, and Clown Service is mentioned.

segments.title: Conan O'Brien stool bit and Mask's standout scenes
segments.summary: Tig describes the stool-pushing bit she performed on Conan O'Brien. The hosts then discuss emotional scenes in Mask, such as the blind camp scene and Rocky's death, and Cher's performance.

segments.title: Movie Crush questions and Roger Ebert review
segments.summary: Chuck reads Roger Ebert's review of Mask. The segment then moves to five movie questions asking about first movie seen in theater, walking out of bad movies, guilty pleasures like Urban Cowboy, and the movie-going rituals.

segments.title: Outro and credits
segments.summary: Chuck wraps up the episode, thanks Tig, and reflects on the emotional start. The episode credits producer Noel Brown.
